title: Blindfold chess simultaneous with GM Vidit Gujrathi
description: Chess Grandmaster Vidit Gujrathi joins the ETHIndia CLS to play three games at once, all blindfolded. The winner of Tuesday’s Knockout Chess tournament will take on him at one of the boards, making this a must-see for any chess fan.
